title: USE | Register a Display / Device
summary: Registering a new display/device adds it to your Digital Signage network so it can receive content.
bodyMd:
Registering a new display/device adds it to your Digital Signage network so it can receive content. Before You Begin: Asset ID or serial number; permissions; store and display type created. Step 1 - Go to Unassigned Devices (Displays & Devices > Unassigned Devices). Step 2 - Complete the Registration Form (next to the device click Register > enter Display Name (Asset ID default, changeable) > select store > choose display type e.g. "Shop-Front-Landscape" > Save). Device now appears under Assigned Devices and can receive scheduled campaigns. Next Steps: Create a New Display Type and Playlist; Add a Campaign to Play on a Digital Signage Display.
